# KloudKIT

> Open-source developer tools that take the friction out of everyday development. Each tool has its own documentation site with an llms.txt index.

## Tools

- [Kloud Workspace](https://ws.kloudkit.com/llms.txt): A batteries-included, pre-configured development workspace inside a Docker container.
- [TestShed](https://testshed.kloudkit.com/llms.txt): A pytest plugin that hands your tests real Docker containers and Playwright browsers as fixtures.
- [Looking Glass](https://lookingglass.kloudkit.com/llms.txt): A drop-in HTTP request reflector that answers every request with exactly what arrived.
- [Portico](https://portico.kloudkit.com/llms.txt): Runs every service of a web app and puts one origin in front of them: one port, no CORS.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/kloudkit): Every tool's source code and issue tracker.
